device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS micro-power SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: ads7886.pdf (SLAS492B) p.3 pin configuration and functions (DBV, DCK), p.5-6 electrical characteristics (full-scale 0 to VDD, VDD 2.35-5.25 V), p.7 timing requirements (td1 25 ns, td2 25 ns, td4 30 ns max at 3 V; Figure 1: 4 leading zeros, 12 data bits), p.8 Figure 2, p.15 normal operation and power-down mode (Figure 28)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.5-6 (specs), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.8 (Figure 2), p.15 (operation, power-down, Figure 28)
notModeled: analog input (0 V to VDD; VDD is also the reference); the conversion is clocked by SCLK (not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

frame: the first zero is clocked out by the CS falling edge and each SCLK falling edge shifts the next bit (read on the rising edge): SPI mode 0 shape; SDO goes 3-state after the 16th SCLK falling edge (idle "z") or at CS rising

power-down: CS high after the 2nd and before the 10th SCLK falling edge powers the device down; a dummy frame of at least 10 SCLK falling edges wakes it (power-up time 1 us); frames during wake-up return invalid data
CS high before the end of the conversion aborts it (SDO 3-state; no valid data in the next frame)
digital inputs may go up to 5.25 V regardless of VDD (p.15); not expressed (vcc max is 5.25 V)
quiet time tq, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits; delays at VDD = 3 V (the maximum) are used
variants: ADS7886S and ADS7886SB grades share the spec; ADS7887/ADS7888 are the 10/8-bit versions (ads7887.pdf)
